author: Rex <game88521@gmail.com>

suites.name: meridian-city-models
limitations: 完整公車／NG3續玩使用明示240／360m直線fixture，真正FreeCar行駛並由產品規則結算；不代表全城真人駕駛。
合作角色邊界與照片順序使用明示姿態fixture；真城市道路與真WS實車另由meridian-city-node驗證。
相片實際像素／下載、手機排版另由本機browser驗證；未使用實機。

suites.name: meridian-city-node
limitations: 2／3／4車真WS操控真FreeCar完成同一段真城市直路及2秒作業，非真人全城長篇劇本。
逾時／重連與TTL明示使用伺服器時鐘；錯層／捕捉／長任務結算明示使用服務內姿態／結果fixture。
免費Render負載與手機網路未量測，未連線任何公開主機。

suites.name: meridian-city-client-node
limitations: transport明示為記憶體WebSocket適配器，使用真正MeridianCityClient、MeridianCityService與FreeCar；真網路frame另由meridian-city-node／browser驗證。
長場序號以server已確認超過一萬包的明示fixture初始化，避免測試無意灌流量。

suites.name: meridian-social-node
limitations: Full rotations use normal-duration idle FreeCars: these establish equal opportunities, lifecycle and isolation, not human drift skill or multiplayer latency quality. Party restart restores a lobby summary, never a moving car.

suites.name: meridian-navigator-node
limitations: Complete road-gate scoring is checked with explicit server crossing fixtures. Actual input drives a real FreeCar, but this is not a human full-route driving, latency/balance, real-phone or remote-host capacity claim.

suites.name: meridian-platform-browser
limitations: 桌面Chrome手機尺寸模擬，不是實機效能證明。
影片使用明示靜止車輛及接觸事件fixture，真城市場景及MediaRecorder。

suites.name: meridian-racing-browser
limitations: 桌面Chrome獨立context與尺寸模擬，不是真機／跨網路或人工全程試駕；fixture由個案另外明示。
主頁TT以虛擬input.read控制器、真__gp.step/Car.update駛完有效圈，非BOT參數、無手寫sample。GP排位／衝刺／正賽完賽及維修區姿態為明示權威fixture；真Car接力服務區路段另見Node1056步證據。

suites.name: meridian-social-browser
limitations: 桌面Chrome獨立context與尺寸模擬，不是真機／跨網路或人工全程試駕；fixture由個案另外明示。

No injected phase, finish, score or car position. Rotations start through UI but their full normal-duration schedules are separately exercised in meridian-social-node. Browser tests cover native entry, waiting control gates, private proof acknowledgment and same-browser restoration, crew calls and layouts; not real phones or remote capacity.

suites.name: meridian-city-browser
limitations: 桌面Chrome獨立context與尺寸模擬，不是真機／跨網路或人工全程試駕；fixture由個案另外明示。
續玩UI以真規則時鐘在原地保存，完整真FreeCar續玩由Node直路測試證明。最後階段原子結算、照片拍攝與合作作業明示使用fixture到站位置／進度；不宣稱多人全城人工試駕。
合作server autoTick停用：模擬步由測試驅動；長按輸入仍經原生pointer／真WS，TTL的真時鐘邊界由Node另測。

suites.name: meridian-city-save-hud-browser-fixed
limitations: 桌面Chrome獨立context與尺寸模擬，不是真機／跨網路或人工全程試駕；fixture由個案另外明示。
只驗儲存失敗提示的修前／修後對照。公車到站與照片已完成狀態採明示fixture；完整行車和拍攝另由主suite及Node驗證。
--expect-fixed=0刻意測主代理保留的修前dist；source hashes僅記錄執行時工作樹，dist build為實際受測版本。

suites.name: aurora-city-models
limitations: Node測試包含真FreeCar直路fixture，不代表真手機手感。
MediaRecorder真實影片編碼與下載需本機瀏覽器驗證，Node僅驗剪輯時間與相容選擇。

suites.name: aurora-racing-node
limitations: Cup result branches use labelled finish fixtures; full legacy four-match true-Car/WebSocket tests remain separate.
Rally road tests use actual FreeCar/collider and controls through the true service with an EventEmitter transport, not internet or human balance.
Built-in ghost traces are actual offline recorded control runs. Teaching success and real-player drift balance require human trials.
Strategy is a hypothetical estimate; assertions do not claim predicted lap-time accuracy.

suites.name: aurora-duty-node
limitations: 作業閉環使用明示事故與勤務站停靠／檢查點fixture；真FreeCar、城市路網與服務不替換，不代表真人跑完全程。
長按與8秒期限由真30Hz服務運算；沒有外網容量、實機手機或四人真人駕駛證據。

suites.name: aurora-social-node
limitations: Crown and chase finish by actual authority ticks with normal idle spawns, not a human skill/balance test. Convoy is validated through real route construction and true input movement, not its full road journey. No browser, phone or external-host capacity claim.

suites.name: frontier-rally-node
limitations: Gate/scoring cases explicitly arrange server-side previous/current poses at each real-road gate. They prove direction, level, timing and scoring rules, not human complete-route driving. A separate case advances the actual FreeCar with real controls. The browser/client cases use genuine loopback WS with no public services.

suites.name: frontier-performance-history-node
limitations: Uses actual parsers and storage/backup code with isolated in-memory Storage ports. Compare-before-write is a change guard, not an atomic cross-tab lock. Device performance and rendering are tested separately.
This measures these editor chunks only; it is not a claim of total startup speed or mobile FPS improvement.
靜態檢查 COPY、Dockerfile專用ignore、Node執行期import閉包（去除TS型別）、城市tile資產；未執行Docker build或容器啟動。

otherDevelopmentFailures: 早期 racing Node 8 PASS／1 FAIL 的原latest被子代理覆寫；另存明標依壓縮摘要重建的局部失敗紀錄，不冒充原始收據。
中間 build 曾因領航 reason 型別聯集漏項而失敗，已修正。
舊 aurora-racing-node 第一次漏 --experimental-transform-types，在任何個案前無法解析；正確命令14/14 PASS。
PowerShell重導stderr曾把Vite警告包成NativeCommandError；最終命令明確傳遞npm exit code，build為0。
limitations: 只測本機 dist 4317 與 loopback WebSocket；隔離桌面Chrome contexts與viewport不代表實體手機或外網真人。
賽事晉級／交棒UI、城市終段／停靠／合作作業與影片事件部分使用明示fixture；真Car／FreeCar道路、真WS與控制另外驗證，不宣稱人工跑完全程。
真TT指令為轉向、煞車與自動加速模型；不是類比油門，參考走線不寫入PB。
效能資料是CPU回呼／提交採樣；8249 gzip bytes只指兩個編輯器延後量，不代表FPS、總啟動時間、GPU、耗電或溫度成效。
影片為真MediaRecorder編碼／解碼，受瀏覽器支援限制；Docker只靜態閉包，沒有image實測。
跨程序續局需要固定MERIDIAN_CHECKPOINT_SECRET；只驗簽章與原席權限，沒有持久防重播資料庫。
實體手機、真手把、外網多人、玩法平衡、免費主機四人容量及長時間GPU／溫度／耗電尚未驗證。
